title: Land Producer – Showset (BIM)
purpose: Zone production leadership role responsible for orchestrating Showset scope within a defined area ('Land'/Zone) of a large project. Integrates creative, technical, and production planning across disciplines; coordinates Showset interfaces with all technical trades; and stewards BIM deliverables and coordination aligned to program milestones.
authority_statements: Enforces adoption of BIM Constitution standards, Showset conventions, and information requirements within the Zone
Validates Showset scope boundaries and interfaces in the Zone
Approves Zone-level changes to Showset scope representation prior to milestone release
Holds final say on readiness of Zone Showset model segments, sheets, and schedules for publication at milestones based on externalized checks
Sets and maintains Zone interface expectations between Showset and adjacent disciplines
Does not author discipline-specific technical content for non-Showset disciplines
Does not override BIM standards or BIM Manager's governance
Does not replace Project Manager's contractual authority
responsibilities: Ensure Showset Leads apply BIM standards, parameter schemas, naming conventions, view templates, and sheet guidelines in the Zone
Lead federated model reviews on ACC for the Zone, verifying spatial coordination, clearances, and interfaces
Represent Zone in all BIM meetings, report progress, capture decisions, and coordinate with client/consultants
Direct Showset Leads on priorities and sequence; align Zone look-ahead with production schedules and dependencies
Oversee Zone-level drawing set curation for Showset (plans, sections, details)
Set up and maintain Zone production schedules with production team
Run disciplined change control across Zone artifacts; document rationale and impacts prior to milestone release
Approve Zone Showset packages for milestone release in coordination with PM and BIM Manager
accountabilities: Fitness-for-purpose of Zone Showset models, drawings, and data to support coordination, fabrication, installation, and show integration
Alignment of Zone deliverables with BIM milestones, package boundaries, and model-of-record expectations
Coordinated outcomes between Showset and all intersecting disciplines within the Zone
approvals: Zone Showset model segments, drawings, and package readiness for milestone releases
Zone-level changes to Showset scope representation
inputs: Master Project Schedule and milestone deadlines from PM
BEP, MIDP, and coordination status from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
Showset model segments from Showset Leads
Interface reservation requirements from Architecture, MEP, and Tech disciplines
outputs: Zone Showset drawing packages, plans, sections, and details
Zone federated review issue logs and interface agreements
Showset element schedules and interface registers
Zone look-ahead and production milestone schedules
interfaces_with_roles: Discipline Leads (Arch, Struct, MEP, Controls, Lighting, Audio, Video, SFX)
